## backdown mail merge {#merge}

Merge copies of the same mailbox taken at different times (Maildir, mbox files, a Thunderbird folder, or whole mail stores, mailbox by mailbox) into one Maildir: every message once by Message-ID, in the folder the newest copy has it in, flags combined. The sources are only read.

```text
backdown mail merge [OPTIONS] --to <TO> <SOURCES>...
```

### Arguments

`<SOURCES>...`
: The copies of the mailbox: Maildirs, mbox files, Thunderbird account folders, or whole mail stores (folders of Maildirs), in any order. They are only read.

### Options

`--to <TO>`
: The merged Maildir: a new folder (running again carries on where it stopped).

`--dry-run`
: Read everything and show what the merge would be, writing nothing.

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

## backdown mail export {#export}

Export one Maildir folder (its own messages, not its subfolders) as an mbox file (mboxrd)

```text
backdown mail export [OPTIONS] --mbox <MBOX> <MAILDIR>
```

### Arguments

`<MAILDIR>`
: The Maildir folder to export (its own messages, not its subfolders).

### Options

`--mbox <MBOX>`
: The mbox file to write (never overwritten).

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Messages are matched by Message-ID and body (or, without a Message-ID, by headers and body); each lands in the folder the newest copy has it in, with read, replied and flagged marks combined. The destination must be new or empty; it becomes a Maildir++ mailbox. Every message is written, read back and journaled; an interrupted merge carries on when run again. Dovecot mdbox and sdbox aren't read yet. `export` never overwrites the mbox file. `merge` exits 2 when some messages failed.

## Examples

```sh
# what the merge would be (writes nothing)
backdown mail merge /media/old-drive/Mail/Inbox /media/laptop-2012/Mail/Inbox --to /media/archive/Mail/merged --dry-run
backdown mail merge /media/old-drive/Mail/Inbox /media/laptop-2012/Mail/Inbox --to /media/archive/Mail/merged
backdown mail export /media/archive/Mail/merged --mbox /media/archive/Mail/inbox.mbox
```
